name: Lorentz-acceleration kernel and species scaling verification
purpose: Verify q(E+v cross B)/m, charge sign, neutral behavior, and species mass scaling.
configuration: At least one configured ion plus uniform E and B with coupler off.
units: C, kg, V m^-1, T, m s^-1, m s^-2
frame_time_convention: Single declared Cartesian model frame; static fixture.
procedure: Call the production acceleration and subtract independently evaluated gravity to isolate Lorentz acceleration.
acceptance_criteria: Ion components <=1e-13 relative and neutral Lorentz residual exactly zero.
expected_pass_result: Production Lorentz term matches q/m scaling and vector direction.
status_semantics: SKIPPED if no charged species is compiled.
skip_reason: The active SpeciesList contains only neutral Na; all ion indices are disabled.
missing_capability: A supported test configuration containing a real ion species.
